verdict: Controlled private beta only. Public launch for hundreds of businesses and paid subscriptions remain blocked until the applicable gates below are verified.

observations.title: Live release
observations.detail: finviant.com/www returned HTTP 200 without a Vercel sign-in redirect. Deployment dpl_8HpqyfUaRXQgc8LAcFyX2cFRDFTB was READY; domain branch binding matches this branch. Project metadata still says SSO/all: verify actual per-environment protection rather than treating that metadata or noindex as authentication.
observations.evidence: Vercel get_deployment/get_project and unauthenticated HTTP reads

observations.title: Private-beta population
observations.detail: 1 business, 1 Auth account, 1 enrolled test slot. ten_pro_test_accounts, tier_testing and private_beta_email_delivery are enabled. These observations do not establish capacity for hundreds of businesses.

observations.title: Current backend
observations.detail: The public domain serves the existing staging/private-beta Supabase project xvybcmyoblfgzokaifsx. The separate production project qusmeexjbwphoezlcmie is not the domain-bound backend; its release/migration/restore readiness was not certified by this review.
observations.evidence: Deployment environment guard, prior domain verification and active beta database

observations.title: Integrations
observations.detail: 1 activated email sender and 4 delivered outbox records; beta recipient approval remains enforced. 0 active SMS senders; 0 configured/live verified payment merchants. 1 Outlook integration marked connected, no Google connection. A connected row is not refresh/sync certification. Preview environment metadata contains Outlook configuration names and no Google configuration names; values were not retrieved.
observations.evidence: Aggregate delivery/merchant/calendar SQL and encrypted-only Vercel environment metadata

observations.title: Database/security
observations.detail: Database approximately 26 MB; 16 connections observed against max_connections=60 (point-in-time snapshot, not throughput). Every public table has RLS. Security advisor: 0 ERROR categories; leaked-password protection disabled, extension-in-public warning, 5 anon and 40 authenticated definer execution findings; 45 private RLS/no-policy INFO findings require intentional deny-by-default review.
observations.evidence: Supabase security advisor and aggregate database SQL

observations.title: Database/performance
observations.detail: Performance advisor: 23 auth_rls_initplan WARN findings, 49 unindexed foreign-key INFO findings, 39 unused-index INFO findings, 1 auth connection-budget INFO finding. Index recommendations need measured plans and workload; unused indexes are not automatic deletion candidates.

observations.title: Workers and queues
observations.detail: Three cron jobs are active: calendar each minute, tier delivery each 5 minutes, recurring invoice drafts each 15 minutes. Last-24-hour scheduler records: calendar 1,168 runs, tier delivery 288, recurring drafts 96, zero scheduler failures. Calendar queue currently empty. SQL cron success can merely mean an HTTP job was dispatched; verify worker response/completion and end-to-end lag separately.
observations.evidence: cron.job / cron.job_run_details and aggregate calendar queue SQL; commands/credentials were not retrieved

observations.title: Storage and telemetry
observations.detail: Business logos are publicly served, 2 MB/file; receipt/job photos and document PDFs use private buckets (10 MB and 8 MB/file respectively). PostHog exists with opt-in, allowlisted events/properties and replay disabled. No Sentry or Vercel Speed Insights SDK was found. The runtime API rejected a 24h lookup as Hobby retention; a 30m grouped lookup returned no rows, not an uptime/error-free certificate.
observations.evidence: Storage metadata, src/lib/analytics.ts, package/source inspection and Vercel logs API

observations.title: Validation limits
observations.detail: Latest feature evidence: 152 tier/handler/database checks, 55 startup/build checks and card DOM journeys passed in the preceding release. Current audit: npm production and full dependency audits each report 0 advisories. Fresh GitHub checks confirm Calendar integration checks failed at 5963cd5 and Pricing tier checks failed at 6e3f1a4; detailed triage and a complete green release remain CI-01. The old eight-hour campaign is historical and did not exercise hundreds of authenticated tenants concurrently.
observations.evidence: Previous release receipts; fresh npm audit --omit=dev / npm audit; CI definitions and preserved historical logs; https://github.com/Velnu38/Velnu/actions/runs/42505556501 and https://github.com/Velnu38/Velnu/actions/runs/42505357331

tasks.title: Choose and rehearse the production cutover
tasks.why: The domain still uses the beta backend. A URL/key swap can strand business data, storage, tokens and callbacks.
tasks.acceptance: Approve production ownership, stable release branch, data/storage/auth migration or retention plan, all migrations, environment-bound secrets/redirects, backup and rollback; rehearse with a second tenant before moving domains. No automatic cutover in this assessment.

tasks.title: Use commercial hosting and set budget alerts
tasks.why: The runtime API identifies Hobby retention; Hobby is not a commercial launch plan. Supabase compute/backups/provider quotas also need verification.
tasks.acceptance: Confirm Vercel commercial plan and Supabase paid production sizing/backup coverage; approve provider budgets, spend alerts, pause behavior and log retention. Record actual plan evidence; purchasing/upgrading is not performed by this audit.

tasks.title: Release ordinary customer onboarding safely
tasks.why: The ten-tester grant, tier testing and approved-recipient rules cannot be the production entitlement model.
tasks.acceptance: Test signup, email verification, password recovery, company setup, agreement acceptance, invitations/revocations and deletion with genuine separate owners; preserve operator-only test tools, disable public test Pro grants and data-reset beta behavior only in the approved production environment.

tasks.title: Restore a green release gate for current user flows
tasks.why: Some browser/financial fixtures predate the PDF handoff and current labels; the domain-bound branch auto-deploys before a complete test certificate.
tasks.acceptance: Update obsolete fixtures without weakening functional assertions; pass complete current build, financial/tenant/voice/storage/calendar and authenticated browser journeys for the same immutable release commit. Enforce required checks and staged deployment/promotion before domain release; unify supported Node versions and include the actual release branch in CI.

tasks.title: Harden Auth and privileged accounts
tasks.why: Compromised-password protection is disabled; public signup needs operational abuse controls.
tasks.acceptance: Enable and verify leaked-password protection, MFA for infrastructure/operators, production Auth SMTP/redirects/session policy, least-privilege access and recovery. Verify bot/rate controls on signup, recovery and verification; record lockout/recovery tests.

tasks.title: Finish independent tenant, RPC and storage security review
tasks.why: RLS presence and zero ERROR lints do not prove correct policies; public definer/token endpoints intentionally bypass normal login.
tasks.acceptance: Review all anon/authenticated definer grants and fixed search paths, operator functions, AI/tool authorization, customer token expiry/revocation, storage isolation, webhook signatures/replay and CSP. Test at least two real tenant sessions across role changes and expired sessions; clear exploitable high findings and record intentional exceptions. Never add permissive policies to internal deny-by-default tables.

tasks.title: Add distributed abuse limits and backpressure
tasks.why: Monthly quotas, one calendar OAuth limiter and client buttons are not complete per-minute abuse protection.
tasks.acceptance: Enforce account/business/IP burst limits on public token reads, signup, AI/voice, PDF, OCR, uploads and sends; verify retry-after behavior, concurrent quota races, upload/content bounds and global provider-cost ceilings. Use a shared store or atomic database counters, not per-instance memory alone.

tasks.title: Prove backup and recovery
tasks.why: No current restore drill or storage recovery evidence establishes a safe recovery point.
tasks.acceptance: Confirm database backups/PITR as selected, separately back up private storage objects and configuration, restore an isolated full business and verify document/file hashes, permissions and financial totals. Measure recovery time/data loss against approved RTO/RPO; protect backup credentials and rehearse rollback.

tasks.title: Install operational monitoring and route alerts
tasks.why: PostHog is product analytics, not an error or uptime monitor; limited/empty runtime logs leave major blind spots.
tasks.acceptance: Configure Sentry or equivalent error tracing, Vercel real-user Web Vitals, synthetic public/authenticated smoke monitors, provider/queue/DB dashboards and spend alerts. Scrub contact/document content, tokens, query strings and audio. Trigger a test incident and verify it reaches the named on-call owner; set retention and sampling budgets.

tasks.title: Verify scheduled work and reconcile uncertain deliveries
tasks.why: Active cron schedules and accepted HTTP dispatches do not establish successful background work.
tasks.acceptance: Observe actual worker completion, heartbeat age, queue lag, failed/dead tasks, token refresh, provider 429s, expired leases, duplicate/missed runs and outage recovery. Provide operator review for uncertain sends; alert without automatically duplicating a possibly delivered message.

tasks.title: Tune RLS, queries and connection budgets
tasks.why: Advisors flag 23 RLS evaluation warnings and 49 missing FK indexes on a tiny database.
tasks.acceptance: Review plans on representative tenant sizes; fix applicable auth initplan patterns and high-value FK/filter/order indexes, then rerun tenant authorization tests. Verify transaction pooler/TLS/dedicated calendar role, aggregate serverless pool limits (calendar pool max=3 per instance), Auth reserve, timeouts and pagination. Measure before/after; do not blindly drop 39 unused indexes.

tasks.title: Measure capacity with realistic isolated tenant load
tasks.why: One business and a malformed-input campaign do not establish a hundreds-of-business capacity claim.
tasks.acceptance: Use isolated, provider-approved staging and synthetic distinct authenticated tenants; run smoke, 10/50/100-concurrent-user ramps across at least 300 workspaces, then a 60-minute soak and queue catch-up. Cover realistic invoices/jobs/history/photos, concurrent bookings/payments, PDF/AI/OCR work with bounded stub providers, and second-tenant isolation. Record p95/p99 latency, failures, saturation and cost; proceed toward 1,000 workspaces only after the first target passes.

tasks.title: Release general transactional email
tasks.why: Current active sender/delivered records are restricted beta evidence; arbitrary customers remain excluded.
tasks.acceptance: Validate production SPF/DKIM/DMARC and alignment, authorized reply routing for each business, signup emails, attachments, customer/card links, suppression/bounce/complaint handling, delivery events and quota exhaustion; verify controlled inbox receipt before deliberately changing beta recipient policy. Inbox placement cannot be guaranteed.

tasks.title: Implement and reconcile paid subscription activation
tasks.why: Subscription status/cancellation code exists, but no verified purchase-to-entitlement checkout path is established.
tasks.acceptance: Verify live product/price mapping, checkout, signed billing events, idempotency and reconciliation, renewals, failed payments/grace, upgrades/downgrades, cancellation/refunds and owner-only billing. Paid entitlements must come from verified provider state, never user metadata or test tier selection.

tasks.title: Activate and certify managed SMS
tasks.why: No SMS sender is active. Card SMS code is implemented and should not be rebuilt as unfinished work.
tasks.acceptance: Complete provider registration, verified sending/reply route, opt-in/STOP/START handling, signed callbacks, consent/recipient scope, segment-cost display and quota tests on controlled live numbers. Check uncertain sends/reconciliation and cross-business sender isolation. Keep activation gates until accepted.

tasks.title: Certify customer merchant payments and reconciliation
tasks.why: No live verified merchant is configured. Mark Paid remains a manual record, not a charge.
tasks.acceptance: Verify merchant onboarding, hosted checkout/payment links, account binding, signatures/replay, deposit/partial/full payments, refunds/disputes, dashboard balance and activity. Test and live modes stay separate; link visits must never mark paid. Native Tap to Pay is separately deferred.

tasks.title: Finish Google setup and multi-account calendar certification
tasks.why: No Google connection/configuration names observed; one connected Outlook row does not prove multi-tenant refresh reliability.
tasks.acceptance: Finish the Google external OAuth app/verification as required, scopes/redirects, publishing and token refresh; verify Google and Outlook connections, refresh/reconnect/revoke, background sync, conflicts, duplicates, time zones/DST and job/calendar consistency with separate accounts.

tasks.title: Verify AI, voice and receipt scanning live
tasks.why: Mocked quota/transcript checks are useful but do not establish provider/model access or real phone behavior. Receipt scanning uses AWS Textract.
tasks.acceptance: Validate actual configured AI/model access, per-business provider budgets, request review/confirmation, failure recovery and two genuine tenant sessions; test iPhone/Android microphones/codecs, slow networks and receipt OCR-to-expense accuracy with controlled provider calls. Record unit costs and degraded/manual alternatives.

tasks.title: Validate remaining advertised external integrations
tasks.why: QuickBooks is bounded read-only import; Google review requests are personal-app links, not a certified Google Business Profile integration.
tasks.acceptance: Test QuickBooks OAuth refresh/disconnect, supported transaction import/pagination and reconciliation against a controlled real company. Verify all advertised receipt/review/payment/calendar claims match live capability; finish integration or label setup requirements before selling that benefit.

tasks.title: Complete real-device and accessibility acceptance
tasks.why: Desktop browser and DOM contact downloads do not certify native contact saving or phone document/voice flows.
tasks.acceptance: Test current iPhone Safari and Android Chrome: card Save to Contacts, file/native share, PDFs, approval/booking/payment links, voice permission/fallback and interrupted sessions; verify keyboard/screen reader, zoom, touch targets and critical workflows without lost edits.

tasks.title: Set customer support, privacy and incident operations
tasks.why: Hundreds of businesses need a staffed response path, data handling rules and operator safeguards.
tasks.acceptance: Assign support/on-call ownership, severity/response targets, incident and breach escalation, least-privilege support access, customer data export/deletion/retention procedures, documented status/maintenance communication and reviewed customer/privacy terms. Confirm refund/cancellation procedures before charging.

tasks.title: Validate tier unit economics and shared capacity
tasks.why: 200 SMS segments and 600 Fin requests are finite business-wide limits; no zero-cost scaling assumption is justified.
tasks.acceptance: Measure per-tenant AI/voice/OCR/email/SMS/storage/egress/support costs and p50/p95 usage, alert at 80/100% capacity, preserve manual workflows and explicit upgrade links. Assess larger SMS capacity or optional opt-in prepaid purchases without automatic unexpected charges; disclose all shared limits.

tasks.title: Extend owner-controlled follow-up automation
tasks.why: Scheduled email/overdue invoice reminders already exist; broader estimate/appointment automation is optional expansion.
tasks.acceptance: Add only needed follow-up rules with owner enablement, reviewed timing, response/payment suppression and retry safety; do not advertise unimplemented rules.

tasks.title: Expand migration and complete business archives
tasks.why: Customer CSV/vCard and service/workbook exports exist; historical document/address import and full archive are incomplete.
tasks.acceptance: Define a versioned full export/import including addresses, document/PDF/photo history, roles and financial references; provide chunked exports beyond the existing 50,000-record scan boundary and test restore/duplicates.

tasks.title: Dedicated customer site
tasks.why: Keep the requested future item; it is not required for independent document, booking, payment or E-Business Card pages.
tasks.acceptance: Implement only after a future owner-approved portal scope; current standalone action pages remain supported.

tasks.title: Native Tap to Pay and expanded field-worker tools
tasks.why: Manual/external payments and internal worker profiles are distinct from native card acceptance, payroll/GPS or worker login/notifications.
tasks.acceptance: Obtain a separate approved scope, provider/device feasibility, pricing and security validation before development; do not imply these are included now.

recommendations.tool: Vercel commercial plan + Observability + Speed Insights
recommendations.purpose: Hosting, server logs and real-user loading/responsiveness
recommendations.current: Commercial eligibility/retention requires attention; Speed Insights SDK not found.
recommendations.configuration: Confirm plan, then add route-normalized Web Vitals: p75 LCP/INP/CLS by device; request error/latency dashboards and tested alerts. Strip share/OAuth tokens and query-string PII.
recommendations.cost: Paid hosting/optional monitoring usage; owner approval before purchases.

recommendations.tool: Sentry React + server/Edge tracing (or one equivalent)
recommendations.purpose: Actionable errors, release-linked stack traces and sampled traces
recommendations.configuration: Private source-map upload by immutable release; request IDs across Vercel/Supabase/providers; no default PII, document bodies, voice or card/share tokens. Replay off initially; limited sampling and retention.
recommendations.cost: Start small; verify current free/paid quotas. No account created or SDK installed by this assessment.

recommendations.purpose: Detect blank pages, failed sign-in and broken customer journeys
recommendations.current: No external alert delivery was verified.
recommendations.configuration: Check home and branded demo every 1–5 minutes; isolated authenticated synthetic test for dashboard and a read-only customer journey; page a named owner on sustained failure.
recommendations.cost: Choose one hosted service or approved existing monitor; set cadence and budget explicitly.

recommendations.tool: Supabase advisors + database statistics + restore tooling
recommendations.purpose: Query, RLS, connection, queue and recovery health
recommendations.current: Available; advisor findings and cron metadata inspected.
recommendations.configuration: Review expensive plans using representative data; alert on saturation/dead jobs/queue age. Verify DB backup/PITR and separate storage backup through an actual isolated restore.
recommendations.cost: Production compute/backups/PITR may add charges; confirm actual settings before selecting.

recommendations.configuration: Use bounded isolated staging ramps with thresholds/abort limits; Lighthouse budgets for home/auth/dashboard/card; stub billable providers. Correlate results with DB/worker saturation.
recommendations.cost: Local/open-source runners possible; cloud load-generator usage optional and approval-dependent.

recommendations.tool: GitHub dependency review/Dependabot + secret scanning/CodeQL + OWASP ZAP baseline
recommendations.purpose: Supply chain, exposed secrets, static and passive web checks
recommendations.current: Fresh npm audits show zero advisories; comprehensive scanning configuration not certified.
recommendations.configuration: Pin actions and dependencies; scan PRs; store scrubbed evidence; passive baseline on authorized staging plus authenticated tenant tests. Manual review remains necessary for financial/RPC authorization.
recommendations.cost: Feature availability depends on repository visibility and GitHub plan. No intrusive live scan performed.

recommendations.tool: Distributed rate limiter + existing provider dashboards
recommendations.current: Quotas and a calendar OAuth limit exist; broad burst coverage not found.
recommendations.configuration: Prefer existing atomic Postgres limits initially or a shared Redis/Upstash store if measurements justify it. Enforce server-side; monitor Resend bounce/complaints, Twilio opt-outs/segments, Stripe events and AI spend.
recommendations.cost: Avoid adding Redis or overlapping APM products until required; provider costs remain usage-based.

recommendations.current: Installed; opt-in, event allowlist, replay disabled.
recommendations.configuration: Keep for product questions, maintain consent/scrubbing and investigate usage funnels; use operational monitoring separately.
recommendations.cost: Retain existing stack; do not duplicate analytics by default.

recommendations.tool: Existing ChatGPT GitHub, Vercel and Supabase connections
recommendations.purpose: Read configuration/CI evidence and maintain the assessment
recommendations.current: Already connected and used in this review; no additional admin plugin is required for the current audit.
recommendations.configuration: Use these for administration and evidence. Customer-facing error/performance monitoring still requires the actual app SDKs, platform settings, dashboards and alert routes above; installing a chat plugin alone does not instrument Finviant.
recommendations.cost: Retain existing connections; avoid migrating backend platforms or installing unrelated plugins to solve monitoring.
